name: Shafiur Rahman
contribution: He was shot on 22 February while demonstrations expanded beyond the university area and later died of his injuries.
impact: His death extended the memory of Ekushey beyond a single day and underlined the movement's spread into the city.
highlight: Shafiur Rahman was shot on Nawabpur Road on 22 February 1952 and later died at Dhaka Medical College Hospital.
seoTitle: Shafiur Rahman: Language Martyr of 22 February 1952
seoDescription: Learn about Shafiur Rahman's shooting on Nawabpur Road and his place in the memory of the 1952 Language Movement.
shortAnswer: Shafiur Rahman was a civilian killed after being shot during the 22 February 1952 Language Movement demonstration in Dhaka.
